list.name: service_group
list.query: select distinct coalesce(service_group, '(none)') as __text, coalesce(service_group, '(none)') as __value from control.instance_inventory where is_active order by 1
list.label: Service Group

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct (ix.instance_pk, ix.dbid, ix.index_relid)) as "Total Indexes" from fact.pg_index_stat_delta ix join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = ix.instance_pk where ix.sample_ts >= now() - interval '1 hour' and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null)

with idx_usage as (select ix.instance_pk, ix.dbid, ix.index_relid, ix.schemaname, ix.index_relname, coalesce(sum(ix.idx_scan_delta), 0) as total_scans from fact.pg_index_stat_delta ix join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = ix.instance_pk where ix.sample_ts >= now() - interval '30 days' and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by ix.instance_pk, ix.dbid, ix.index_relid, ix.schemaname, ix.index_relname having coalesce(sum(ix.idx_scan_delta), 0) = 0), idx_size as (select rs.instance_pk, rs.dbid, rs.schemaname, rs.relname, rs.index_size_bytes from fact.pg_relation_size_snapshot rs where rs.snapshot_ts = (select max(snapshot_ts) from fact.pg_relation_size_snapshot) and rs.relkind = 'i' and coalesce(rs.index_size_bytes, 0) > 104857600) select count(*) as "Unused Indexes" from idx_usage u join idx_size s on s.instance_pk = u.instance_pk and s.dbid = u.dbid and s.schemaname = u.schemaname and s.relname = u.index_relname

select count(*) as "Missing Index Suspects" from (select t.instance_pk, t.dbid, t.relid from fact.pg_table_stat_delta t join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = t.instance_pk where $__timeFilter(t.sample_ts) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by t.instance_pk, t.dbid, t.relid having coalesce(sum(t.seq_scan_delta), 0) > coalesce(nullif(sum(t.idx_scan_delta), 0), 1) * 100 and coalesce(sum(t.seq_tup_read_delta), 0) > 100000) sub

select t.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, t.schemaname || '.' || t.relname as relation, coalesce(sum(t.seq_scan_delta), 0) as seq_scans, coalesce(sum(t.idx_scan_delta), 0) as idx_scans, case when coalesce(sum(t.idx_scan_delta), 0) = 0 then coalesce(sum(t.seq_scan_delta), 0) else round(coalesce(sum(t.seq_scan_delta), 0)::numeric / nullif(sum(t.idx_scan_delta), 0), 1) end as seq_idx_ratio, coalesce(sum(t.seq_tup_read_delta), 0) as seq_tup_read, coalesce(rs.table_size_bytes, 0) as table_size_bytes from fact.pg_table_stat_delta t join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = t.instance_pk left join lateral (select rs2.table_size_bytes from fact.pg_relation_size_snapshot rs2 where rs2.instance_pk = t.instance_pk and rs2.dbid = t.dbid and rs2.schemaname = t.schemaname and rs2.relname = t.relname and rs2.relkind = 'r' order by rs2.snapshot_ts desc limit 1) rs on true where $__timeFilter(t.sample_ts) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by t.instance_pk, i.display_name, t.schemaname, t.relname, t.dbid, rs.table_size_bytes having coalesce(sum(t.seq_scan_delta), 0) > coalesce(nullif(sum(t.idx_scan_delta), 0), 1) * 100 and coalesce(sum(t.seq_tup_read_delta), 0) > 100000 order by seq_scans desc limit 30

with idx_usage as (select ix.instance_pk, ix.dbid, ix.schemaname, ix.table_relname, ix.index_relname, coalesce(sum(ix.idx_scan_delta), 0) as total_scans_30d from fact.pg_index_stat_delta ix join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = ix.instance_pk where ix.sample_ts >= now() - interval '30 days' and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by ix.instance_pk, ix.dbid, ix.schemaname, ix.table_relname, ix.index_relname having coalesce(sum(ix.idx_scan_delta), 0) = 0) select u.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, u.index_relname as index_name, u.table_relname as table_name, coalesce(rs.index_size_bytes, 0) as index_size_bytes, u.total_scans_30d from idx_usage u join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = u.instance_pk left join lateral (select rs2.index_size_bytes from fact.pg_relation_size_snapshot rs2 where rs2.instance_pk = u.instance_pk and rs2.dbid = u.dbid and rs2.schemaname = u.schemaname and rs2.relname = u.index_relname and rs2.relkind = 'i' order by rs2.snapshot_ts desc limit 1) rs on true where coalesce(rs.index_size_bytes, 0) > 104857600 order by index_size_bytes desc limit 30
